work.sub: Production-focused projects where model quality, system reliability, and product usefulness are all first-class constraints.

projects.title: NeuroMap
projects.blurb: 3D brain-tumor segmentation with voxel-level uncertainty quantification — 0.81 Dice with Monte Carlo Dropout entropy maps for safer clinical review.

details.problem: Standard 3D segmentation models output deterministic masks, leaving clinicians no signal about where the model is uncertain — a problem at tumor boundaries where errors matter most. Volumes also exceed single-pass GPU memory, making naive inference infeasible.
details.approach: Built a 3D U-Net inference pipeline using MONAI sliding-window patching with mixed precision to handle 4-channel NIfTI volumes on a single GPU. Replaced deterministic outputs with Monte Carlo Dropout, running multiple stochastic forward passes per volume to compute voxel-level entropy and variance. Wrapped the model in a FastAPI inference service with a Next.js client for interactive 3D point-cloud reconstruction and slice-by-slice overlays.
details.results: Achieved 0.81 validation Dice while delivering interpretable uncertainty maps that highlight high-risk tumor edges. End-to-end inference runs on a single GPU; the web UI makes results inspectable for non-technical reviewers.

projects.title: Second Brain
projects.blurb: Local-first RAG over a 500-document Obsidian vault. 0.74 MRR, 88% top-3, 96% top-5 across 84 evaluation queries — measured, not vibes.

details.problem: Personal knowledge bases are valuable enough that I didn't want them flowing through third-party inference APIs. And LLM-on-notes tools are usually evaluated by gut feel — not a real basis for iterating on retrievers.
details.approach: Built a fully local retrieval system over an Obsidian vault using Ollama for inference and ChromaDB for vector search with nomic-embed-text embeddings. Designed a FastAPI backend with streaming SSE responses and source attribution so every answer carries citation links back to the source notes. Wrote a formal evaluation harness with 84 labeled queries spanning 20 domains, measuring top-k hit rate and MRR to enable reproducible comparisons across embedding models and chunking strategies.
details.results: 0.74 MRR, 88% top-3 hit rate, 96% top-5 hit rate over a 500-document corpus. Every response is grounded with source citations, and the eval harness lets me swap retrievers and measure the delta instead of guessing.

projects.title: GlassBox
projects.blurb: Credit-default system built around algorithmic trust — Explainable Boosting Machine, DiCE counterfactuals verified by Z3, conformal prediction bounds.

details.problem: Credit-default models that beat baselines on AUC are useless in regulated settings if you can't explain a denial or give applicants a path to approval. Most XAI tooling produces post-hoc rationalizations rather than mathematically sound recourse.
details.approach: Trained an Explainable Boosting Machine as the core classifier, prioritizing interpretability over deep-learning AUC. Built an automated recourse engine using DiCE for counterfactual generation and Z3 formal verification to guarantee the counterfactuals are actually feasible. Layered on a governance suite with Demographic Parity fairness audits, Split Conformal Prediction bounds, and stability simulations for drift and privacy budgets (epsilon=1.0).
details.results: Achieved 0.8961 AUC, beating standard deep-learning baselines on this task. Every prediction ships with a fairness check, calibrated uncertainty bound, and a verified counterfactual the user can act on.

projects.title: Mint Sage
projects.blurb: AI personal-finance assistant with a hybrid ML + rule-based pipeline for noisy transaction text. 92% categorization accuracy on real bank data.

details.problem: Bank transaction strings are noisy and adversarial — pure ML classifiers misclassify high-stakes edge cases (rent, taxes, transfers) that users won't tolerate getting wrong, and pure rule-based systems can't keep up with merchant-name drift.
details.approach: Built a hybrid pipeline combining supervised classification with a rule-based fallback for business-critical categories. Layered in time-series forecasting for spending trends and projected cash flow, surfaced as plain-language insights. Shipped the full stack on React/Next.js with a Node.js backend and Supabase for data and auth.
details.results: 92% categorization accuracy on labeled transaction data. Users get automated expense categorization, anomaly alerts, and forecast-driven cash-flow insights without manual tracking.

projects.title: Stock Monk
projects.blurb: LSTM + NLP stock-price predictor that fuses news/social sentiment with historical OHLCV trends.

details.problem: Equity prediction models that ignore market sentiment miss the dominant short-term signal. The challenge was fusing news/social sentiment with historical price action without the sentiment channel drowning out the time-series.
details.approach: Trained an LSTM on multi-year OHLCV data, fine-tuned a transformer on financial news for sentiment, and concatenated the sentiment embedding with price features at the LSTM input. Used walk-forward validation across market regimes.
details.results: Outperformed price-only baseline by ~12% MAPE on held-out windows. Pipeline runs nightly and emits a daily forecast bundle.

projects.title: Sanvad
projects.blurb: Multilingual conversational chatbot built on LLMs and Indic-language models, robust to code-mixed Hinglish.

details.problem: Most chatbots collapse on Indic-language inputs, especially code-mixed Hinglish, because the tokenizers and retrievers were never trained for it.
details.approach: Routed inputs through language ID, used Indic-tuned encoders for retrieval, and wrapped generation in a LangChain agent that fell back to translation when confidence was low.
details.results: Stable conversational quality across English, Hindi, and code-mixed inputs in user testing.

projects.title: Doctorify
projects.blurb: Mobile-first disease-triage app for underserved and rural communities.

details.problem: Rural patients lack access to specialists for triage of common dermatological and ophthalmological conditions.
details.approach: Built a Flutter UI for on-device image capture, server-side classifiers (Scikit + CV) trained on public condition datasets, and a triage flow that escalated urgent cases to clinicians.
details.results: Demoed live triage across three condition classes and reached early clinical advisors for feedback.

projects.title: Sprout
projects.blurb: Postnatal mental-health companion using AI-driven sentiment monitoring with a clinician dashboard.

details.problem: Postpartum mental-health symptoms often go undetected because there's no low-friction way for new parents to journal and surface concerning patterns to clinicians.
details.approach: Flutter app for daily voice/text journaling, Python backend with a fine-tuned sentiment model, AWS deployment, and a clinician dashboard for trend review.
details.results: Pilot ran with a small cohort. Sentiment trends correlated with self-reported PHQ-9 deltas across the cohort.

items.title: AI Engineering Intern
items.blurb: Owned the production CV pipeline behind MobiNext's surveillance ecosystem — from model fine-tuning to AWS deployment to operator-facing tools.
highlights: Architected a modular AWS infrastructure (EC2, S3, EKS, Lambda, API Gateway) serving real-time YOLOv8 inference across 120 IP cameras at 12 sites, hitting 99.98% uptime under sustained load.
Fine-tuned four YOLOv8 detection models with custom PyTorch training pipelines, improving mAP by 20.3% and cutting false positives by 60% on held-out evaluation sets.
Lifted night-time detection accuracy by 35% via CLAHE preprocessing and HSV color-space augmentations — preprocessing-driven gains where retraining was infeasible.
Rebuilt the operator ROI-selection tool in React after watching site staff struggle with the original CLI workflow, eliminating engineering support for routine camera reconfigurations.
